decisions.reason: This burner component builds directly on the firm's core radiant-heater know-how and its in-house R&D, so the firm can interpret results and refine it within its established business.
This multi-model electric infrared panel line is a flagship that extends existing infrared expertise toward electrification, which fits the firm's strategic direction and its absorptive capacity.
The halogen infrared heater is close to the firm's infrared knowledge and has its own page, though as a single niche product it carries somewhat higher risk of portfolio pruning.
This multi-model industrial electric hall heater line sits squarely in the firm's hall-heating expertise and customer base, enabling learning from field results through its service network.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a flagship already in real operation, aligned with the low-carbon direction and supported by in-house R&D and industry research cooperation.
